validity.researcher_notes: Tooling constraints this run: gem.wiki 403s on every automated path (documented run-wide escalation, wiki_citations.json empty for this row too), this session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before I could run a single query, and every general search engine I tried via WebFetch (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Ecosia, Brave, Mojeek, Marginalia) returned a CAPTCHA, 403/429, or a garbage/unrelated results page instead of real SERPs. Direct fetches to sngpl.com.pk (obfuscated JSP CMS, no discoverable transmission-network subpage), ogra.org.pk (403), and psx.com.pk (404 on the guessed report path) were also unproductive. So no citable URL specifically naming 'Jauharabad-Chashma Gas Pipeline' was found, and none is proposed. However this is NOT a bare existence flag: this batch's own already-staged GulfPub (Petroleum Economist) reconciliation crosswalk (recon_gulfpub_crosswalk.json) independently corroborates that SNGPL operates a cluster of real, named 8-inch-diameter gas trunk lines in exactly this corridor -- Quaidabad-Chashma (44.573 km, composite 0.68, diam 8in, operator SNGPL), Chashma-Piplan (14.717 km, explicitly flagged 'PARTIAL COVERAGE -- corroborates this row's LOCATION only, not its length, capacity or extent'), Shakardara-Lachi (30.121 km) and two Lachi-Bakhar variants (140.2 km and 86.8 km) -- all attributed to SNGPL, all 8in diameter, matching GEM's Diameter=8in exactly and GEM's Owner1=SNGPL exactly. That is genuine independent (tier-2, single-source) evidence that SNGPL-operated 8in gas transmission infrastructure of this general type physically exists in the Khushab/Chashma corridor, so I am not calling this a phantom/hallucination. The problem is specific attribution: none of the independent GulfPub records use the name 'Jauharabad' -- the closest and best-scoring match is 'Quaidabad-Chashma' at 44.573 km (recon's own len_flag: 'DELTA 46%' vs GEM's 82.21 km). Wikipedia confirms Quaidabad is a separate town/tehsil in the SAME Khushab District as Jauharabad (the district's capital), on the same Lahore-Mianwali road that continues to Chashma -- so a real corridor Jauharabad->Quaidabad->Chashma is geographically plausible, and GEM's longer 82.21 km figure could legitimately be the combined Jauharabad-to-Chashma run (of which Quaidabad-Chashma is just the final ~45 km leg) rather than an error -- but that is a hypothesis, not something I could independently confirm this run. Separately: no duplicate risk found in the roster -- P4134 reads as the natural next segment after P4133 (Kot Momin-Jauharabad, 72.41 km, same 8in diameter, same LastUpdated batch), i.e. proper corridor segmentation (Kot Momin -> Jauharabad -> Chashma), not a double-count. Classification as 'transmission' is consistent with how SNGPL/GulfPub classify these long intercity 8in trunk lines (not gathering/distribution), so no classification concern. Net: existence of SOME real SNGPL 8in line to Chashma in this corridor is independently supported; the specific 82.21 km / 'Jauharabad' attribution on this exact row is not, and should be treated as unverified until someone with working search/gem.wiki access checks an SNGPL network map or OGRA report directly.
